# LibreOffice Calc GUI Interface Description

## Application Window

- **Title Bar**
  - Displays the file name: `invoices.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc`
  - Shows the current date and time: `Oct 23 16:51`
  - Contains window control buttons: Minimize, Maximize/Restore, Close (on the right)

- **Application Menu Bar**
  - Contains standard menu items: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Sheet, Data, Tools, Window, Help

- **Toolbar**
  - Contains a variety of icons for common functions including:
    - File operations (New, Open, Save, Print)
    - Clipboard operations (Cut, Copy, Paste)
    - Formatting tools (Bold, Italic, Underline, Font color, Text alignment)
    - Cell operations (Fill color, Borders, Merge cells)
    - Data operations (Sort ascending/descending, Filter)
    - Chart and object insertion tools
    - Formula and function tools (Sum, Percentage, Currency formatting)
    - Drawing tools (Shapes, Lines, Arrows)
    - Special characters and symbols (Omega, Link, Comment)
    - Cell formatting (Number formatting, Decimal places, Currency, Percentage)
    - View and layout tools (Gridlines, Page setup)

- **Formula Bar**
  - Displays the current cell reference: `F2`
  - Shows the current font: `Calibri`
  - Shows the current font size: `11 pt`
  - Displays the current cell value: `366.83`
  - Contains formula editing tools: `f.`, `Σ`, `=`

## Status Bar

- **Left Side**
  - Displays the current sheet: `Sheet 1 of 1`
  - Shows the current sheet name: `Invoices`
  - Indicates the current page style: `PageStyle_Invoices`

- **Center**
  - Displays the current language setting: `English (Hong Kong)`

- **Right Side**
  - Displays statistical information: `Average: 366.83; Sum: 366.83`
  - Contains zoom control: `100%`
  - Contains zoom slider and +/- buttons for adjusting zoom level

## Sidebar (Right Panel)

- **Navigation Panel**
  - Contains a vertical stack of icons for quick access to:
    - **File Manager** (folder icon)
    - **Spreadsheet** (green icon with grid)
    - **Presentation** (orange icon with slide)
    - **Database** (blue icon with table)
    - **Drawing** (black icon with paintbrush)
    - **Help** (blue question mark)
    - **Recycle Bin** (green recycle bin icon)

- **Function Panel**
  - Contains a vertical stack of icons for quick access to:
    - **Function Wizard** (f(x) icon)
    - **Chart Wizard** (chart icon)
    - **Styles** (paintbrush icon)
    - **Format Painter** (paintbrush icon)
    - **Comment** (speech bubble icon)
    - **Object** (object icon)
    - **Insert** (insert icon)

## Worksheet Area

- **Grid**
  - Contains a grid of cells organized in rows and columns.
  - Row numbers are displayed on the left: 1, 2, 3, ..., 36
  - Column letters are displayed at the top: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, L, M, N, O, P, Q

- **Cell Content**
  - **Row 1 (Header Row)**
    - Column A: `Invoice Number`
    - Column B: `Date`
    - Column C: `Client Name`
    - Column D: `Item Description`
    - Column E: `Quantity`
    - Column F: `Unit Price`
    - Column G: `Total`
    - Column H: `Payment Status`
  - **Rows 2-11 (Data Rows)**
    - Each row contains data corresponding to the headers.
    - Example: Row 2 contains `INV-2023-001`, `2023-11-14`, `Acme Corp`, `Graphic Design`, `4`, `366.83`, `1467.32`, `Paid`

- **Selected Cell**
  - Cell `F2` is currently selected.
  - The cell value is `366.83`.
  - The cell is highlighted with a red border.

## Notification Bar

- **Top Notification Bar**
  - Contains two informational messages:
    - `Help us make LibreOffice even better!`
    - `Your donations support our worldwide community.`
  - Contains two buttons:
    - `Get involved`
    - `Donate`

## Desktop Environment
